proof_body:
by
  intro a b ha hb
  have hab : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
  have hs : 0 < a + b := by linarith
  have hg : 0 < Real.sqrt (a * b) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hab
  have hgg : Real.sqrt (a * b) ^ 2 = a * b := Real.sq_sqrt hab.le
  have hmid : Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a + b) / 2 :=
    Real.sqrt_le_iff.2 ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b)]⟩
  refine ⟨?_, hmid, ?_⟩
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hs]
    nlinarith
  · exact (Real.le_sqrt' (by positivity)).2 (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b)])
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a → 0 < b → 2 * a * b / (a + b) ≤ Real.sqrt (a * b) ∧ Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a + b) / 2 ∧ (a + b) / 2 ≤ Real.sqrt ((a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / 2)
